title: Detecting Temporal Concepts in Video Transformers via a No-False-Positives Test
abstract: arXiv:2610.33353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video models have the architecture to support encoding temporal aspects of the input, i.e. concepts that require more than one frame to define, like object movement. However, because motion and appearance change are entangled, a feature that appears to encode temporal concepts like object movement may instead encode non-temporal concepts like spatial presence at different positions whose activations merely correlate with motion. To resolve this, we introduce the No-False-Positives (NFP) test, a statistical test with a formal guarantee of statistical specificity for identifying features encoding temporal concepts. Using specially designed stimuli, we apply this test to representations produced by VideoMAE, V-JEPA2, and TimeSformer, and observe that temporal features exist in each model. translated_title: 通过无假阳性检验检测视频Transformer中的时间概念
translated_abstract: 视频模型具有支持编码输入时间方面的架构，即需要多于一帧来定义的概念，例如物体运动。然而，由于运动和外观变化相互纠缠，一个看似编码了物体运动等时间概念的特征，实际上可能编码的是非时间概念，例如不同位置的空间存在，其激活仅仅与运动相关。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了无假阳性检验，这是一种具有统计特异性形式保证的统计检验，用于识别编码时间概念的特征。使用专门设计的刺激，我们将该检验应用于VideoMAE、V-JEPA2和TimeSformer产生的表征，并观察到每个模型中都存在时间特征。我们首先通过证明该检验在DINOv2图像编码器上不会产生时间特征来验证该检验的有效性。然后，利用合成表征空间，我们展示了[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 本文提出具有统计特异性形式保证的无假阳性检验，用于识别视频Transformer中真正编码时间概念的特征，并验证了VideoMAE、V-JEPA2和TimeSformer中均存在时间特征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the No-False-Positives (NFP) test, a statistical test with formal guarantees of specificity, to identify features that genuinely encode temporal concepts in video transformers, and verifies that temporal features exist in VideoMAE, V-JEPA2, and TimeSformer.
